   192	  /**
   193	   * Start heartbeat interval for v2 clients
   194	   */
   195	  startHeartbeat(): void {
   196	    if (this.heartbeatInterval) {
   197	      return;
   198	    }
   199	
   200	    this.heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
   201	      const now = Date.now();
   202	      const heartbeat: HeartbeatMessage = {
   203	        type: 'heartbeat',
   204	        timestamp: now,
   205	        serverTime: now,
   206	      };
   207	
   208	      for (const [ws, client] of this.clients) {
   209	        if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN && client.protocolVersion === '2.0') {
   210	          ws.send(JSON.stringify(heartbeat));
   211	        }
   212	      }
   213	    }, 30000); // 30 second interval
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  /**
   217	   * Stop heartbeat interval
   218	   */
   219	  stopHeartbeat(): void {
   220	    if (this.heartbeatInterval) {
   221	      clearInterval(this.heartbeatInterval);
   222	      this.heartbeatInterval = null;
   223	    }
   224	  }

   238	  /**
   239	   * Handle new WebSocket connection
   240	   */
   241	  private handleConnection(ws: WebSocket, req: IncomingMessage): void {
   242	    const ip = getClientIp(req);
   243	    const url = new URL(req.url || '/', `http://${req.headers.host}`);
   244	    const providedToken = url.searchParams.get('token');
   245	    const protocolVersion = url.searchParams.get('v') || '1.0';
   246	
   247	    // Detect client type: query param overrides header/User-Agent detection
   248	    const clientTypeParam = url.searchParams.get('clientType') as ClientType | null;
   249	    const clientType: ClientType = clientTypeParam || detectClientType(req);
   250	
   251	    // Authenticate
   252	    if (providedToken !== this.config.token) {
   253	      console.log(`[WSHub] Unauthorized connection from ${ip}`);
   254	      // Trace auth failure
   255	      const observability = getObservability();
   256	      if (observability.isEnabled()) {
   257	        observability.traceAuthFailure(ip, 'invalid_token');
   258	      }
   259	      ws.close(4001, 'Unauthorized');
   260	      return;
   261	    }
   262	
   263	    const clientId = `${clientType}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
   264	    const now = Date.now();
   265	
   266	    const clientInfo: ClientInfoV2 = {
   267	      ip,
   268	      connectedAt: now,
   269	      authenticated: true,
   270	      clientId,
   271	      clientType,
   272	      sessionId: null,
   273	      priority: clientType === 'pc' ? 'high' : 'normal',
   274	      protocolVersion,
   275	      lastHeartbeat: now,
   276	    };
   277	
   278	    this.clients.set(ws, clientInfo);
   279	    console.log(`[WSHub] Client ${clientId} connected from ${ip} (${this.clients.size} total)`);
   280	
   281	    // Track connection in Opik (both tracers)
   282	    const ipHash = createHash('sha256').update(ip).digest('hex').slice(0, 12);
   283	    getOpikTracer().clientConnected(this.config.sessionId, {
   284	      clientId,
   285	      clientType,
   286	      ipHash,
   287	      connectedAt: now,
   288	    });
   289	
   290	    // Trace client connection (enhanced observability)
   291	    const observability = getObservability();
   292	    if (observability.isEnabled()) {
   293	      observability.traceClientConnection(clientType, 'connect');
   294	    }
   295	
   296	    // For v2 protocol, send auth_success and session_list
   297	    if (protocolVersion === '2.0') {
   298	      const authSuccess: AuthSuccessMessage = {
   299	        type: 'auth_success',
   300	        clientId,
   301	        protocolVersion: '2.0',
   302	        clientType,
   303	      };
   304	      this.sendToClient(ws, authSuccess);
   305	
   306	      // Send session list if session manager available
   307	      const sessionMgr = this.sessionManager;
   308	      if (sessionMgr) {
   309	        const sessions = sessionMgr.getAllSessions();
   310	        const sessionList: SessionListMessage = {
   311	          type: 'session_list',
   312	          sessions: sessions.map((s) => ({
   313	            id: s.id,
   314	            state: s.state,
   315	            createdAt: s.createdAt.getTime(),
   316	            lastActivity: s.lastActivity.getTime(),
   317	            agentConfig: s.agentConfig,
   318	            workingDirectory: s.workingDirectory,
   319	            connectedClients: sessionMgr.getSessionClients(s.id).length,
   320	          })),
   321	        };
   322	        this.sendToClient(ws, sessionList);
   323	      }
   324	    } else {
   325	      // v1 protocol - send initial session info
   326	      const agents = this.agentManager?.getAllAgentInfos() || [];
   327	
   328	      // Auto-set focusedAgentId to first agent for v1 clients
   329	      if (agents.length > 0 && clientInfo) {
   330	        clientInfo.focusedAgentId = agents[0].id;
   331	      }
   332	
   333	      this.sendToClient(ws, {
   334	        type: 'session_info',
   335	        sessionId: this.config.sessionId,
   336	        isReadOnly: this.isReadOnly,
   337	        agents,
   338	        timestamp: Date.now(),
   339	      });
   340	    }
   341	
   342	    // Handle messages
   343	    ws.on('message', (data) => {
   344	      try {
   345	        const message = JSON.parse(data.toString());
   346	        this.handleMessage(ws, message);
   347	      } catch (error) {
   348	        console.error('[WSHub] Parse error:', error);
   349	        this.sendToClient(ws, {
   350	          type: 'error',
   351	          message: 'Invalid message format',
   352	          timestamp: Date.now(),
   353	        });
   354	      }
   355	    });
   356	
   357	    ws.on('close', () => {
   358	      const client = this.clients.get(ws);
   359	      if (client?.sessionId) {
   360	        // Remove from arbiter
   361	        const arbiter = this.sessionArbiters.get(client.sessionId);
   362	        if (arbiter) {
   363	          arbiter.removeClient(client.clientId);
   364	        }
   365	
   366	        // Notify other clients in session
   367	        this.broadcastToSession(
   368	          client.sessionId,
   369	          {
   370	            type: 'client_left',
   371	            clientId: client.clientId,
   372	          } as ClientLeftMessage,
   373	          client.clientId
   374	        );
   375	
   376	        // Detach from session
   377	        this.sessionManager?.detachClient(client.clientId);
   378	      }
   379	
   380	      // Track disconnection in Opik
   381	      if (client) {
   382	        const connectionDuration = Date.now() - client.connectedAt;
   383	        getOpikTracer().clientDisconnected(
   384	          this.config.sessionId,
   385	          client.clientId,
   386	          connectionDuration
   387	        );
   388	      }
   389	
   390	      this.clients.delete(ws);
   391	      this.controlRequestRateLimiter.delete(client?.clientId || '');
   392	      console.log(`[WSHub] Client disconnected (${this.clients.size} remaining)`);
   393	
   394	      // Trace client disconnect
   395	      if (client) {
   396	        const obs = getObservability();
   397	        if (obs.isEnabled()) {
   398	          obs.traceClientConnection(client.clientType, 'disconnect');
   399	        }
   400	      }
   401	    });
   402	
   403	    ws.on('error', (error) => {
   404	      console.error(`[WSHub] Client error:`, error.message);
   405	    });
   406	  }

   408	  /**
   409	   * Handle incoming message from client
   410	   */
   411	  private handleMessage(ws: WebSocket, message: ClientMessage): void {
   412	    const clientInfo = this.clients.get(ws);
   413	    if (!clientInfo?.authenticated) {
   414	      this.sendToClient(ws, {
   415	        type: 'error',
   416	        message: 'Not authenticated',
   417	        timestamp: Date.now(),
   418	      });
   419	      return;
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    switch (message.type) {
   423	      case 'input':
   424	        // Validate input data is present
   425	        if (typeof message.data !== 'string') {
   426	          console.warn('[WSHub] input message missing data field');
   427	          break;
   428	        }
   429	        this.handleInput(ws, message.agentId, message.data);
   430	        break;
   431	
   432	      case 'resize':
   433	        if (this.agentManager) {
   434	          // Support both v1 (with agentId) and v2 (without agentId) resize messages
   435	          const resizeAgentId =
   436	            'agentId' in message ? message.agentId : clientInfo.focusedAgentId || '';
   437	          this.agentManager.resizeAgent(resizeAgentId, message.cols, message.rows);
   438	        }
   439	        break;
   440	
   441	      case 'create_agent':
   442	        this.handleCreateAgent(ws, message.config);
   443	        break;
   444	
   445	      case 'kill_agent':
   446	        this.handleKillAgent(ws, message.agentId, message.signal);
   447	        break;
   448	
   449	      case 'switch_agent':
   450	        // Update client's focused agent
   451	        clientInfo.focusedAgentId = message.agentId;
   452	        break;
   453	
   454	      case 'list_agents':
   455	        this.sendToClient(ws, {
   456	          type: 'agent_list',
   457	          agents: this.agentManager?.getAllAgentInfos() || [],
   458	          timestamp: Date.now(),
   459	        });
   460	        break;
   461	
   462	      case 'mode_change':
   463	        this.setReadOnly(message.readOnly);
   464	        break;
   465	
   466	      case 'ping':
   467	        this.sendToClient(ws, { type: 'pong', timestamp: Date.now() });
   468	        break;
   469	
   470	      // v2 Protocol Messages
   471	      case 'session_attach':
   472	        this.handleSessionAttach(ws, message as SessionAttachMessage);
   473	        break;
   474	
   475	      case 'session_detach':
   476	        this.handleSessionDetach(ws);
   477	        break;
   478	
   479	      case 'scrollback_request':
   480	        this.handleScrollbackRequest(ws, message as ScrollbackRequestMessage);
   481	        break;
   482	
   483	      case 'heartbeat_ack':
   484	        this.handleHeartbeatAck(ws, message as HeartbeatAckMessage);
   485	        break;
   486	
   487	      case 'control_request':
   488	        this.handleControlRequest(ws, message as ControlRequestMessage);
   489	        break;
   490	
   491	      case 'terminal_input': {
   492	        // v2 terminal input with arbiter check
   493	        // Support both v1 (input) and v2 (data) field names for backwards compatibility
   494	        const terminalMsg = message as { data?: string; input?: string; agentId?: string };
   495	        const inputData = terminalMsg.data ?? terminalMsg.input;
   496	        const agentId = terminalMsg.agentId || clientInfo.focusedAgentId || '';
   497	
   498	        // Validate input data is present
   499	        if (typeof inputData !== 'string') {
   500	          console.warn('[WSHub] terminal_input missing data field');
   501	          break;
   502	        }
   503	
   504	        // Check arbiter if client is attached to a session
   505	        if (clientInfo.sessionId) {
   506	          const arbiter = this.sessionArbiters.get(clientInfo.sessionId);
   507	          if (arbiter) {
   508	            const result = arbiter.processInput(clientInfo.clientId, inputData);
   509	            if (!result.accepted) {
   510	              // Input rejected by arbiter - message already sent via event
   511	              break;
   512	            }
   513	          }
   514	        }
   515	
   516	        this.handleInput(ws, agentId, inputData);
   517	        break;
   518	      }
   519	
   520	      case 'approval_response':
   521	        this.handleApprovalResponse(ws, message as ApprovalResponseMessage);
   522	        break;
   523	
   524	      default:
   525	        console.warn('[WSHub] Unknown message type:', (message as Record<string, unknown>).type);
   526	    }
   527	  }

   532	  private handleSessionAttach(ws: WebSocket, message: SessionAttachMessage): void {

   577	    }

    14	// Simple .env loader (no external dependency needed)
    15	function loadEnvFile(): void {
    16	  // Check multiple locations: CWD, then package root
    17	  const candidates = [
    18	    join(process.cwd(), '.env'),
    19	    join(process.cwd(), 'packages', 'cli', '.env'),
    20	  ];
    21	
    22	  for (const envPath of candidates) {
    23	    if (existsSync(envPath)) {
    24	      try {
    25	        const content = readFileSync(envPath, 'utf-8');
    26	        for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    27	          const trimmed = line.trim();
    28	          // Skip comments and empty lines
    29	          if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
    30	          const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
    31	          if (eqIdx === -1) continue;
    32	          const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
    33	          let value = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();
    34	          // Strip surrounding quotes (single or double)
    35	          if ((value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'")) ||
    36	              (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"'))) {
    37	            value = value.slice(1, -1);
    38	          }
    39	          // Only set if not already defined (system env takes priority)
    40	          if (key && !process.env[key]) {
    41	            process.env[key] = value;
    42	          }
    43	        }
    44	        break; // Use first found .env
    45	      } catch {
    46	        // Ignore read errors
    47	      }
    48	    }
    49	  }
    50	}

   308	interface WizardOptions {
   309	  preset?: string;
   310	  guardrails?: string;
   311	  dir?: string;
   312	  tmux?: boolean;
   313	  port?: string;
   314	  code?: boolean;
   315	  webUrl?: string;
   316	  yes?: boolean;
   317	  json?: boolean;
   318	  timeout?: string;
   319	}
   320	
   321	async function quickStart(options: WizardOptions): Promise<void> {
   322	  const preset = options.preset || 'shell-only';
   323	  const guardrails = options.guardrails || 'default';
   324	  const workDir = resolve(options.dir || process.cwd());
   325	  const jsonOutput = !!options.json;
   326	
   327	  if (!existsSync(workDir)) {
   328	    if (jsonOutput) {
   329	      console.log(JSON.stringify({ error: `Directory does not exist: ${workDir}` }));
   330	    } else {
   331	      console.log(chalk.red(`\n  Directory does not exist: ${workDir}\n`));
   332	    }
   333	    process.exit(1);
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  const presetConfig = AGENT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.name === preset);
   337	  const agents = presetConfig
   338	    ? [...presetConfig.agents]
   339	    : [{ type: 'shell' as const, name: 'Shell', command: getDefaultShell() }];
   340	
   341	  if (!jsonOutput) {
   342	    console.log('');
   343	    p.intro(chalk.bgCyan(chalk.black(` MConnect ${VERSION_DISPLAY} `)));
   344	    console.log(chalk.dim(`  Quick start: preset=${preset}, guardrails=${guardrails}`));
   345	    console.log(chalk.dim(`  Working dir: ${workDir}\n`));
   346	  }
   347	
   348	  try {
   349	    await startSession({
   350	      workDir,
   351	      guardrails,
   352	      agents,
   353	      enableTmux: options.tmux !== false,
   354	      port: options.port ? parseInt(options.port, 10) : undefined,
   355	      webUrl: options.webUrl,
   356	      jsonOutput,
   357	      timeout: parseInt(options.timeout || '60', 10),
   358	    });
   359	  } catch (error) {
   360	    if (jsonOutput) {
   361	      console.log(JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error' }));
   362	    } else {
   363	      p.log.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error');
   364	    }
   365	    process.exit(1);
   366	  }
   367	}
   368	
   369	async function runWizard(options: WizardOptions): Promise<void> {
   370	  console.clear();
   371	
   372	  p.intro(chalk.bgCyan(chalk.black(` MConnect ${VERSION_DISPLAY} `)));
   373	  console.log(chalk.dim('  Multi-Agent Terminal Control with Persistent Sessions\n'));
   374	
   375	  // Agent preset selection
   376	  const preset =
   377	    options.preset ||
   378	    (await p.select({
   379	      message: 'Select agent configuration',
   380	      options: [
   381	        {
   382	          value: 'shell-only',
   383	          label: 'Shell Session',
   384	          hint: 'Single interactive shell (recommended to start)',
   385	        },
   386	        {
   387	          value: 'single',
   388	          label: 'Single Agent (Claude)',
   389	          hint: 'Shell that runs Claude Code',
   390	        },
   391	        {
   392	          value: 'research-spec-test',
   393	          label: 'Research + Spec + Tests',
   394	          hint: '3 shells for parallel ideation',
   395	        },
   396	        {
   397	          value: 'dev-review',
   398	          label: 'Dev + Reviewer',
   399	          hint: '2 shells for development workflow',
   400	        },
   401	        {
   402	          value: 'container-dev',
   403	          label: 'Container Dev (Docker)',
   404	          hint: 'Isolated shell in Docker container',
   405	        },
   406	        {
   407	          value: 'custom',
   408	          label: 'Custom Setup',
   409	          hint: 'Configure multiple shells manually',
   410	        },
   411	      ],
   412	    }));
   413	
   414	  if (p.isCancel(preset)) {
   415	    p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   416	    process.exit(0);
   417	  }
   418	
   419	  // Check Docker availability for container preset
   420	  let finalPreset = preset;
   421	  if (preset === 'container-dev') {
   422	    const containerManager = getContainerManager();
   423	    const dockerStatus = await containerManager.checkDockerStatus();
   424	
   425	    if (!dockerStatus.installed) {
   426	      p.log.warn(
   427	        chalk.yellow(
   428	          'Docker is not installed. Container isolation requires Docker.\n' +
   429	            'Install from: https://docker.com/products/docker-desktop'
   430	        )
   431	      );
   432	      const fallback = await p.confirm({
   433	        message: 'Continue with shell-only preset instead?',
   434	        initialValue: true,
   435	      });
   436	      if (p.isCancel(fallback) || !fallback) {
   437	        p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   438	        process.exit(0);
   439	      }
   440	      finalPreset = 'shell-only';
   441	    } else if (!dockerStatus.running) {
   442	      p.log.warn(
   443	        chalk.yellow(
   444	          'Docker daemon is not running. Please start Docker first.\n' +
   445	            (process.platform === 'darwin'
   446	              ? 'Start Docker Desktop application.'
   447	              : 'Run: sudo systemctl start docker')
   448	        )
   449	      );
   450	      const fallback = await p.confirm({
   451	        message: 'Continue with shell-only preset instead?',
   452	        initialValue: true,
   453	      });
   454	      if (p.isCancel(fallback) || !fallback) {
   455	        p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   456	        process.exit(0);
   457	      }
   458	      finalPreset = 'shell-only';
   459	    } else {
   460	      p.log.info(
   461	        chalk.green(`Docker ${dockerStatus.version || ''} detected - container isolation available`)
   462	      );
   463	    }
   464	  }
   465	
   466	  // Get agents configuration
   467	  let agents: Omit<AgentConfig, 'cwd'>[] = [];
   468	
   469	  if (finalPreset === 'custom') {
   470	    agents = await configureCustomAgents();
   471	  } else {
   472	    const presetConfig = AGENT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.name === finalPreset);
   473	    if (presetConfig) {
   474	      agents = [...presetConfig.agents]; // Clone the array
   475	    } else {
   476	      // Default to shell-only if preset not found
   477	      agents = [
   478	        {
   479	          type: 'shell',
   480	          name: 'Shell',
   481	          command: getDefaultShell(),
   482	        },
   483	      ];
   484	    }
   485	  }
   486	
   487	  // Guardrails selection
   488	  const guardrails =
   489	    options.guardrails ||
   490	    (await p.select({
   491	      message: 'Configure guardrails',
   492	      options: [
   493	        {
   494	          value: 'default',
   495	          label: 'Default',
   496	          hint: 'Block dangerous commands, approve risky ones',
   497	        },
   498	        {
   499	          value: 'strict',
   500	          label: 'Strict',
   501	          hint: 'Require approval for most operations',
   502	        },
   503	        {
   504	          value: 'permissive',
   505	          label: 'Permissive',
   506	          hint: 'Only block critical operations',
   507	        },
   508	        {
   509	          value: 'none',
   510	          label: 'None',
   511	          hint: 'No restrictions (use with caution)',
   512	        },
   513	      ],
   514	    }));
   515	
   516	  if (p.isCancel(guardrails)) {
   517	    p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   518	    process.exit(0);
   519	  }
   520	
   521	  // Working directory
   522	  const defaultDir = options.dir || process.cwd();
   523	  const workDir = await p.text({
   524	    message: 'Working directory:',
   525	    initialValue: defaultDir,
   526	    validate: (value) => {
   527	      if (!existsSync(value)) {
   528	        return 'Directory does not exist';
   529	      }
   530	      return undefined;
   531	    },
   532	  });
   533	
   534	  if (p.isCancel(workDir)) {
   535	    p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   536	    process.exit(0);
   537	  }
   538	
   539	  const finalDir = resolve(workDir as string);
   540	
   541	  // Summary
   542	  p.note(
   543	    [
   544	      `${chalk.bold('Agents:')} ${agents.map((a) => a.name).join(', ')}`,
   545	      `${chalk.bold('Guardrails:')} ${guardrails}`,
   546	      `${chalk.bold('Directory:')} ${finalDir}`,
   547	      `${chalk.bold('Tmux:')} ${options.tmux === false ? 'Disabled' : 'Enabled'}`,
   548	    ].join('\n'),
   549	    'Session Configuration'
   550	  );
   551	
   552	  // Confirm
   553	  const proceed = await p.confirm({
   554	    message: 'Start session?',
   555	    initialValue: true,
   556	  });
   557	
   558	  if (p.isCancel(proceed) || !proceed) {
   559	    p.cancel('Session cancelled.');
   560	    process.exit(0);
   561	  }
   562	
   563	  // Start session
   564	  try {
   565	    await startSession({
   566	      workDir: finalDir,
   567	      guardrails: guardrails as string,
   568	      agents,
   569	      enableTmux: options.tmux !== false,
   570	      port: options.port ? parseInt(options.port, 10) : undefined,
   571	      webUrl: options.webUrl,
   572	      timeout: parseInt(options.timeout || '60', 10),
   573	    });
   574	  } catch (error) {
   575	    p.log.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error');
   576	    process.exit(1);
   577	  }
   578	}
   579	
   580	async function configureCustomAgents(): Promise<Omit<AgentConfig, 'cwd'>[]> {
   581	  const agents: Omit<AgentConfig, 'cwd'>[] = [];
   582	
   583	  const count = await p.text({
   584	    message: 'How many shells/agents?',
   585	    initialValue: '2',
   586	    validate: (value) => {
   587	      const num = parseInt(value, 10);
   588	      if (Number.isNaN(num) || num < 1 || num > 5) {
   589	        return 'Enter a number between 1 and 5';
   590	      }
   591	      return undefined;
   592	    },
   593	  });
   594	
   595	  if (p.isCancel(count)) {
   596	    process.exit(0);
   597	  }
   598	
   599	  const agentCount = parseInt(count as string, 10);
   600	
   601	  for (let i = 0; i < agentCount; i++) {
   602	    p.log.step(`Configure Shell ${i + 1}`);
   603	
   604	    const name = await p.text({
   605	      message: `Shell ${i + 1} name:`,
   606	      initialValue: i === 0 ? 'Main' : `Shell ${i + 1}`,
   607	    });
   608	
   609	    if (p.isCancel(name)) {
   610	      process.exit(0);
   611	    }
   612	
   613	    agents.push({
   614	      type: 'shell',
   615	      name: name as string,
   616	      command: getDefaultShell(),
   617	    });
   618	  }
   619	
   620	  return agents;

   370	// MARK: - Server Message Discriminator
   371	
   372	/// Parsed server message — discriminated union over all server → client message types.
   373	enum ServerMessage: Equatable {
   374	    case authSuccess(AuthSuccessResponse)
   375	    case authFailed(AuthFailedResponse)
   376	    case sessionList(SessionListResponse)
   377	    case sessionState(SessionStateResponse)
   378	    case terminalOutput(TerminalOutputResponse)
   379	    case agentStatus(AgentStatusResponse)
   380	    case agentList(AgentListResponse)
   381	    case controlStatus(ControlStatusResponse)
   382	    case controlResponse(ControlResponse)
   383	    case inputRejected(InputRejectedResponse)
   384	    case scrollbackResponse(ScrollbackResponse)
   385	    case clientJoined(ClientJoinedResponse)
   386	    case clientLeft(ClientLeftResponse)
   387	    case heartbeat(HeartbeatResponse)
   388	    case pong(PongResponse)
   389	    case error(ErrorResponse)
   390	
   391	    /// Parse a JSON data blob into a typed server message.
   392	    static func parse(from data: Data) -> ServerMessage? {
   393	        guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any],
   394	              let type = json["type"] as? String
   395	        else {
   396	            return nil
   397	        }
   398	
   399	        let decoder = JSONDecoder()
   400	
   401	        switch type {
   402	        case "auth_success":
   403	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(AuthSuccessResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   404	            return .authSuccess(msg)
   405	        case "auth_failed":
   406	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(AuthFailedResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   407	            return .authFailed(msg)
   408	        case "session_list":
   409	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(SessionListResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   410	            return .sessionList(msg)
   411	        case "session_state":
   412	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(SessionStateResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   413	            return .sessionState(msg)
   414	        case "terminal_output":
   415	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(TerminalOutputResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   416	            return .terminalOutput(msg)
   417	        case "agent_status":
   418	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(AgentStatusResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   419	            return .agentStatus(msg)
   420	        case "agent_list":
   421	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(AgentListResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   422	            return .agentList(msg)
   423	        case "control_status":
   424	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ControlStatusResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   425	            return .controlStatus(msg)
   426	        case "control_response":
   427	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ControlResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   428	            return .controlResponse(msg)
   429	        case "input_rejected":
   430	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(InputRejectedResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   431	            return .inputRejected(msg)
   432	        case "scrollback_response":
   433	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ScrollbackResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   434	            return .scrollbackResponse(msg)
   435	        case "client_joined":
   436	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ClientJoinedResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   437	            return .clientJoined(msg)
   438	        case "client_left":
   439	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ClientLeftResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   440	            return .clientLeft(msg)
   441	        case "heartbeat":
   442	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(HeartbeatResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   443	            return .heartbeat(msg)
   444	        case "pong":
   445	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(PongResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   446	            return .pong(msg)
   447	        case "error":
   448	            guard let msg = try? decoder.decode(ErrorResponse.self, from: data) else { return nil }
   449	            return .error(msg)
   450	        default:
   451	            return nil
   452	        }
   453	    }
   454	}

    53	/// WebSocket client implementing MConnect protocol v3.
    54	///
    55	/// Manages the full connection lifecycle:
    56	/// 1. Connect to server via `wss://` or `ws://`
    57	/// 2. Authenticate with JWT token (first message)
    58	/// 3. Send/receive typed protocol messages
    59	/// 4. Respond to server heartbeats
    60	/// 5. Automatically reconnect on disconnection with exponential backoff

    95	    /// Exposes the current host for background session restoration.

    99

   103	    /// Maximum number of reconnection attempts before giving up.

   128	    /// every 30 seconds; we allow up to 90 seconds of silence before considering the
   129	    /// connection dead.

   131	    private let heartbeatTimeout: TimeInterval = 90.0

   135	    init(

   137	        authService: AuthService? = nil,
   138	        networkMonitor: NetworkMonitoring = NetworkMonitor.shared
   139	    ) {
   140	        self.tokenManager = tokenManager

   147	
   148	    private func setupNetworkMonitor() {
   149	        networkMonitor.networkRestoredPublisher
   150	            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
   151	            .sink { [weak self] in
   152	                self?.handleNetworkRestored()
   153	            }
   154	            .store(in: &cancellables)

   157	
   158	    /// Called when the network transitions from unreachable → reachable.
   159	    private func handleNetworkRestored() {
   160	        guard !isIntentionalDisconnect, let host = currentHost else { return }
   161	
   162	        switch connectionState {
   163	        case .waitingForNetwork:
   164	            logger.info("Network restored — resuming reconnection immediately")
   165	            reconnectAttempt = 0
   166	            scheduleReconnect(host: host)
   167	        case .reconnecting:
   168	            // Already trying to reconnect; the next attempt will succeed now that

   286	    private func performConnect(host: Host) {

   288	        guard let url = URL(string: "\(scheme)://\(host.hostname):\(host.port)/ws") else {

   353	    private func send<T: Encodable>(_ message: T) {

   379	                case .failure(let error):
   380	                    self.logger.error("Receive error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
   381	                    self.handleConnectionLost()
   382	                }
   383	            }
   384	        }
   385	    }

   387	    // MARK: - Message Handling
   388	
   389	    private func handleRawMessage(_ raw: URLSessionWebSocketTask.Message) {
   390	        let data: Data
   391	        switch raw {
   392	        case .string(let text):
   393	            guard let d = text.data(using: .utf8) else { return }
   394	            data = d
   395	        case .data(let d):
   396	            data = d
   397	        @unknown default:
   398	            return
   399	        }
   400	
   401	        guard let message = ServerMessage.parse(from: data) else {
   402	            logger.warning("Failed to parse server message")
   403	            return
   404	        }
   405	
   406	        handleServerMessage(message)
   407	    }
   408	
   409	    private func handleServerMessage(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   410	        switch message {
   411	        case .authSuccess(let response):
   412	            handleAuthSuccess(response)
   413	        case .authFailed(let response):
   414	            handleAuthFailed(response)
   415	        case .sessionList(let response):
   416	            sessions = response.sessions
   417	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveSessionList: response.sessions)
   418	        case .sessionState(let response):
   419	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveSessionState: response)
   420	        case .terminalOutput(let response):
   421	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveOutput: response.data, fromAgent: response.agentId)
   422	        case .agentStatus(let response):
   423	            updateAgentStatus(agentId: response.agentId, status: response.status)
   424	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveAgentStatus: response.agentId, status: response.status)
   425	        case .agentList(let response):
   426	            agents = response.agents
   427	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveAgentList: response.agents)
   428	        case .controlStatus(let response):
   429	            controlState = response.state
   430	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveControlStatus: response)
   431	        case .controlResponse(let response):
   432	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveControlResponse: response)
   433	        case .inputRejected(let response):
   434	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveInputRejection: response)
   435	        case .scrollbackResponse(let response):
   436	            delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveScrollback: response)
   437	        case .clientJoined(let response):
   438	            delegate?.wsClient(self, clientJoined: response.client)
   439	        case .clientLeft(let response):
   440	            delegate?.wsClient(self, clientLeft: response.clientId)
   441	        case .heartbeat(let response):
   442	            handleHeartbeat(response)
   443	        case .pong:
   444	            break // latency measurement — no-op for now
   445	        case .error(let response):
   446	            handleProtocolError(response)
   447	        }
   448	    }
   449	
   450	    // MARK: - Auth Handling
   451	
   452	    private func handleAuthSuccess(_ response: AuthSuccessResponse) {
   453	        clientId = response.clientId
   454	        reconnectAttempt = 0
   455	        setConnectionState(.connected)
   456	        startHeartbeatTimer()
   457	        logger.info("Authenticated as client \(response.clientId)")
   458	
   459	        // Register push notification device token if available
   460	        if let deviceToken = PushService.shared.deviceToken {
   461	            registerDeviceToken(deviceToken)
   462	        }
   463	
   464	        // Register with background session manager for keepalive
   465	        BackgroundSessionManager.shared.configure(wsClient: self)
   466	
   467	        // Restore session if we have a pending reattach (set during connection loss
   468	        // or preserved across same-host reconnection via BackgroundSessionManager)
   469	        if let sessionId = pendingSessionReattach {
   470	            logger.info("Restoring session attachment to \(sessionId) after reconnection")
   471	            pendingSessionReattach = nil
   472	            attachToSession(sessionId)
   473	            // Request scrollback to catch up on output missed during disconnection
   474	            requestScrollback(sessionId: sessionId, fromLine: 0, count: reconnectScrollbackLines)
   475	        }
   476	    }
   477	
   478	    private func handleAuthFailed(_ response: AuthFailedResponse) {
   479	        logger.warning("Auth failed: \(response.reason.rawValue), retryable: \(response.retryable)")
   480	
   481	        if response.reason == .expiredToken, response.retryable {
   482	            attemptTokenRefreshAndReauth()
   483	        } else {
   484	            disconnect()
   485	        }
   486	    }
   487	
   488	    /// Try to refresh the access token and re-send the auth message.
   489	    private func attemptTokenRefreshAndReauth() {
   490	        guard let host = currentHost else {
   491	            disconnect()
   492	            return
   493	        }
   494	
   495	        let serverURL = "\(host.useTLS ? "https" : "http")://\(host.hostname):\(host.port)"
   496	
   497	        Task {
   498	            do {
   499	                try await authService.refreshAccessToken(serverURL: serverURL)
   500	                sendAuthMessage()
   501	            } catch {
   502	                logger.error("Token refresh failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
   503	                disconnect()
   504	            }
   505	        }
   506	    }
   507	
   508	    // MARK: - Agent State
   509	
   510	    private func updateAgentStatus(agentId: String, status: AgentStatus) {
   511	        if let index = agents.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == agentId }) {
   512	            let agent = agents[index]
   513	            agents[index] = AgentInfo(id: agent.id, name: agent.name, preset: agent.preset, status: status)
   514	        }
   515	    }
   516	
   517	    // MARK: - Heartbeat
   518	
   519	    private func handleHeartbeat(_ response: HeartbeatResponse) {
   520	        lastHeartbeatReceived = Date()
   521	        send(HeartbeatAckMessage(timestamp: response.timestamp))
   522	    }
   523	
   524	    private func startHeartbeatTimer() {
   525	        stopHeartbeatTimer()
   526	        lastHeartbeatReceived = Date()
   527	
   528	        heartbeatTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: heartbeatCheckInterval, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
   529	            Task { @MainActor in
   530	                self?.checkHeartbeat()
   531	            }
   532	        }
   533	    }
   534	
   535	    private func stopHeartbeatTimer() {
   536	        heartbeatTimer?.invalidate()
   537	        heartbeatTimer = nil
   538	    }
   539	
   540	    private func checkHeartbeat() {
   541	        guard let last = lastHeartbeatReceived else { return }
   542	        let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(last)
   543	        if elapsed > heartbeatTimeout {
   544	            logger.warning("Heartbeat timeout (\(elapsed)s since last heartbeat)")
   545	            handleConnectionLost()
   546	        }
   547	    }
   548	
   549	    // MARK: - Error Handling
   550	
   551	    private func handleProtocolError(_ response: ErrorResponse) {
   552	        logger.error("Protocol error [\(response.code.rawValue)]: \(response.message)")
   553	        delegate?.wsClient(self, didReceiveError: response)
   554	
   555	        if response.code == .authExpired || response.code == .authFailed {
   556	            handleConnectionLost()
   557	        }
   558	    }

   127	/**

   130	export class WSHub {
   131	  private config: WSHubConfig;
   132	  private clients: Map<string, ConnectedClient> = new Map();
   133	  private sessionArbiters: Map<string, InputArbiter> = new Map();
   134	  private heartbeatInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
   135	  private authTimeouts: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
   136	
   137	  /** Event handlers */

   139	  private mcpHandlers: Map<string, MCPHandler> = new Map(); // sessionId -> handler

   141	  /** Guardrail configs per session */

   144	  /** Latency tracking */

   147	  constructor(config: Partial<WSHubConfig> = {}) {
   148	    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
   149	    this.latencyTracker = new LatencyTracker({ enabled: true });
   150	  }
   151	
   152	  /**
   153	   * Start the hub (begins heartbeat timer)
   154	   */
   155	  start(): void {
   156	    if (this.heartbeatInterval) {
   157	      return;
   158	    }
   159	
   160	    this.heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
   161	      this.sendHeartbeats();
   162	      this.cleanupStaleClients();
   163	    }, this.config.heartbeatIntervalMs);
   164	  }
   165	
   166	  /**
   167	   * Stop the hub
   168	   */
   169	  stop(): void {
   170	    if (this.heartbeatInterval) {
   171	      clearInterval(this.heartbeatInterval);
   172	      this.heartbeatInterval = null;
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    // Clear all auth timeouts
   176	    for (const timeout of this.authTimeouts.values()) {
   177	      clearTimeout(timeout);
   178	    }
   179	    this.authTimeouts.clear();
   180	
   181	    // Stop all arbiters
   182	    for (const arbiter of this.sessionArbiters.values()) {
   183	      arbiter.stop();
   184	    }
   185	    this.sessionArbiters.clear();
   186	
   187	    // Clear guardrail configs
   188	    this.sessionGuardrails.clear();
   189	
   190	    // Close all connections
   191	    for (const client of this.clients.values()) {
   192	      client.ws.close(1000, 'Hub shutting down');
   193	    }
   194	    this.clients.clear();
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  /**
   198	   * Handle new WebSocket connection
   199	   */
   200	  handleConnection(ws: ServerWebSocket<WebSocketData>): void {
   201	    const clientId = ws.data.clientId;
   202	
   203	    // Create unauthenticated client entry
   204	    const client: ConnectedClient = {
   205	      id: clientId,
   206	      ws,
   207	      userId: '',
   208	      email: '',
   209	      name: '',
   210	      clientType: 'pc', // Will be set on auth
   211	      priority: 'normal',
   212	      sessionId: null,
   213	      connectedAt: new Date(),
   214	      lastHeartbeat: new Date(),
   215	      authenticated: false,
   216	    };
   217	
   218	    this.clients.set(clientId, client);
   219	
   220	    // Set auth timeout - client must authenticate within authTimeoutMs
   221	    const authTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   222	      this.handleAuthTimeout(clientId);
   223	    }, this.config.authTimeoutMs);
   224	    this.authTimeouts.set(clientId, authTimeout);
   225	  }
   226	
   227	  /**
   228	   * Handle incoming WebSocket message
   229	   */
   230	  async handleMessage(ws: ServerWebSocket<WebSocketData>, data: string | Buffer): Promise<void> {
   231	    const stopTimer = this.latencyTracker.startTimer();
   232	
   233	    const clientId = ws.data.clientId;
   234	    const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
   235	
   236	    if (!client) {
   237	      // Unknown client, close connection
   238	      ws.close(1008, 'Unknown client');
   239	      return;
   240	    }
   241	
   242	    // Update last activity
   243	    client.lastHeartbeat = new Date();
   244	
   245	    // Parse message
   246	    let message: ClientMessage;
   247	    try {
   248	      const text = typeof data === 'string' ? data : data.toString('utf-8');
   249	      message = JSON.parse(text) as ClientMessage;
   250	    } catch {
   251	      this.sendError(clientId, 'Invalid JSON message', 'INTERNAL_ERROR', false);
   252	      const latency = stopTimer();
   253	      this.latencyTracker.record('parse_error', latency);
   254	      return;
   255	    }
   256	
   257	    // Handle unauthenticated state - must be auth message

   259	      if (message.type !== 'auth') {
   260	        this.sendAuthFailed(clientId, 'missing_token');

   272	    // Handle authenticated messages
   273	    await this.handleClientMessage(clientId, message);

   275	    // Record latency after message processing completes

   277	    this.latencyTracker.record(message.type, latency);

   501	  }

   503	  /**
   504	   * Attach a client to a session
   505	   */
   506	  attachToSession(clientId: string, sessionId: string): boolean {
   507	    const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
   508	    if (!client) {
   509	      return false;
   510	    }
   511	
   512	    // Detach from current session if attached
   513	    if (client.sessionId) {
   514	      this.detachFromSession(clientId);
   515	    }
   516	
   517	    // Get or create arbiter for session
   518	    let arbiter = this.sessionArbiters.get(sessionId);
   519	    if (!arbiter) {
   520	      arbiter = new InputArbiter(sessionId);
   521	      arbiter.start();
   522	      this.setupArbiterListeners(arbiter);
   523	      this.sessionArbiters.set(sessionId, arbiter);
   524	    }
   525	
   526	    // Add client to arbiter
   527	    arbiter.addClient(clientId, client.clientType, client.priority);
   528	
   529	    // Update client state
   530	    client.sessionId = sessionId;
   531	
   532	    // Broadcast client joined
   533	    this.broadcastToSession(
   534	      sessionId,
   535	      {
   536	        type: 'client_joined',
   537	        client: {
   538	          id: client.id,
   539	          clientType: client.clientType,
   540	          priority: client.priority,
   541	        },
   542	        timestamp: Date.now(),
   543	      } as ClientJoinedMessage,
   544	      clientId
   545	    );
   546	
   547	    // Send control status to client
   548	    this.sendControlStatus(clientId, arbiter);
   549	
   550	    return true;
   551	  }
   552	
   553	  /**
   554	   * Detach a client from its session
   555	   */
   556	  detachFromSession(clientId: string): void {
   557	    const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
   558	    if (!client || !client.sessionId) {
   559	      return;
   560	    }
   561	
   562	    const sessionId = client.sessionId;
   563	    const arbiter = this.sessionArbiters.get(sessionId);
   564	
   565	    if (arbiter) {
   566	      arbiter.removeClient(clientId);
   567	
   568	      // If no more clients in session, stop arbiter and clean up
   569	      if (arbiter.getClients().length === 0) {
   570	        arbiter.stop();
   571	        this.sessionArbiters.delete(sessionId);
   572	        this.sessionGuardrails.delete(sessionId);
   573	      }
   574	    }
   575	
   576	    // Broadcast client left
   577	    this.broadcastToSession(
   578	      sessionId,
   579	      {
   580	        type: 'client_left',
   581	        clientId,
   582	        timestamp: Date.now(),
   583	      } as ClientLeftMessage,
   584	      clientId
   585	    );
   586	
   587	    client.sessionId = null;
   588	  }
   589	
   590	  /**
   591	   * Get connected client count
   592	   */
   593	  getClientCount(): number {
   594	    return this.clients.size;
   595	  }
   596	
   597	  /**
   598	   * Get authenticated client count
   599	   */
   600	  getAuthenticatedClientCount(): number {
   601	    let count = 0;
   602	    for (const client of this.clients.values()) {
   603	      if (client.authenticated) {
   604	        count++;
   605	      }
   606	    }
   607	    return count;
   608	  }
   609	
   610	  /**
   611	   * Get latency metrics for all message types
   612	   */
   613	  getLatencyMetrics(): LatencyMetrics[] {
   614	    return this.latencyTracker.getMetrics();
   615	  }

   618	  // Private Methods
   619	  // ============================================================================

     2	 * JWT Token Management

    10	
    11	// ============================================================================
    12	// Configuration
    13	// ============================================================================
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * JWT configuration options
    17	 */
    18	export interface JWTConfig {
    19	  /** Secret key for signing tokens (min 32 bytes recommended) */
    20	  secret: string;
    21	  /** Token issuer (default: 'mconnect') */
    22	  issuer?: string;
    23	  /** Access token expiration (default: '15m') */
    24	  accessTokenExpiry?: string;
    25	  /** Refresh token expiration (default: '30d') */
    26	  refreshTokenExpiry?: string;
    27	  /** Algorithm to use (default: 'HS256') */
    28	  algorithm?: 'HS256' | 'HS384' | 'HS512';
    29	}
    30	
    31	/**
    32	 * Default configuration
    33	 */
    34	const DEFAULT_CONFIG: Required<Omit<JWTConfig, 'secret'>> = {
    35	  issuer: 'mconnect',
    36	  accessTokenExpiry: '15m',
    37	  refreshTokenExpiry: '30d',
    38	  algorithm: 'HS256',
    39	};
    40	
    41	/**
    42	 * Parse duration string to seconds
    43	 * Supports: s (seconds), m (minutes), h (hours), d (days)
    44	 */
    45	function parseDuration(duration: string): number {
    46	  const match = duration.match(/^(\d+)([smhd])$/);
    47	  if (!match) {
    48	    throw new Error(`Invalid duration format: ${duration}`);
    49	  }
    50	
    51	  const value = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    52	  const unit = match[2];
    53	
    54	  switch (unit) {
    55	    case 's':
    56	      return value;
    57	    case 'm':
    58	      return value * 60;
    59	    case 'h':
    60	      return value * 60 * 60;
    61	    case 'd':
    62	      return value * 60 * 60 * 24;
    63	    default:
    64	      throw new Error(`Invalid duration unit: ${unit}`);
    65	  }
    66	}

    68	// ============================================================================
    69	// JWT Service
    70	// ============================================================================
    71	
    72	/**
    73	 * JWT service for token management
    74	 */
    75	export class JWTService {
    76	  private readonly secret: Uint8Array;
    77	  private readonly config: Required<Omit<JWTConfig, 'secret'>>;
    78	
    79	  constructor(config: JWTConfig) {
    80	    if (!config.secret || config.secret.length < 32) {
    81	      throw new Error('JWT secret must be at least 32 characters');
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    this.secret = new TextEncoder().encode(config.secret);
    85	    this.config = {
    86	      ...DEFAULT_CONFIG,
    87	      ...config,
    88	    };
    89	
    90	    // Validate duration formats eagerly
    91	    parseDuration(this.config.accessTokenExpiry);
    92	    parseDuration(this.config.refreshTokenExpiry);
    93	  }
    94	
    95	  /**
    96	   * Generate a unique token ID (jti)
    97	   */
    98	  private generateJti(): string {
    99	    return crypto.randomUUID();
   100	  }
   101	
   102	  /**
   103	   * Create access token for a user
   104	   */
   105	  async createAccessToken(user: User): Promise<string> {
   106	    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
   107	    const expiresIn = parseDuration(this.config.accessTokenExpiry);
   108	
   109	    const claims: Omit<AccessTokenClaims, 'iat' | 'exp'> = {
   110	      iss: 'mconnect',
   111	      sub: user.id,
   112	      email: user.email,
   113	      name: user.name,
   114	      provider: user.provider,
   115	      jti: this.generateJti(),
   116	    };
   117	
   118	    const token = await new jose.SignJWT(claims as unknown as jose.JWTPayload)
   119	      .setProtectedHeader({ alg: this.config.algorithm })
   120	      .setIssuedAt(now)
   121	      .setExpirationTime(now + expiresIn)
   122	      .sign(this.secret);
   123	
   124	    return token;
   125	  }
   126	
   127	  /**
   128	   * Create refresh token for a user
   129	   */
   130	  async createRefreshToken(userId: string): Promise<{ token: string; jti: string; expiresAt: Date }> {
   131	    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
   132	    const expiresIn = parseDuration(this.config.refreshTokenExpiry);
   133	    const jti = this.generateJti();
   134	
   135	    const claims: Omit<RefreshTokenClaims, 'iat' | 'exp'> = {
   136	      iss: 'mconnect',
   137	      sub: userId,
   138	      jti,
   139	    };
   140	
   141	    const token = await new jose.SignJWT(claims as unknown as jose.JWTPayload)
   142	      .setProtectedHeader({ alg: this.config.algorithm })
   143	      .setIssuedAt(now)
   144	      .setExpirationTime(now + expiresIn)
   145	      .sign(this.secret);
   146	
   147	    const expiresAt = new Date((now + expiresIn) * 1000);
   148	
   149	    return { token, jti, expiresAt };
   150	  }
   151	
   152	  /**
   153	   * Create a token pair (access + refresh) for a user
   154	   */
   155	  async createTokenPair(user: User): Promise<TokenPair & { refreshTokenJti: string; refreshTokenExpiresAt: Date }> {
   156	    const accessToken = await this.createAccessToken(user);
   157	    const { token: refreshToken, jti, expiresAt } = await this.createRefreshToken(user.id);
   158	    const expiresIn = parseDuration(this.config.accessTokenExpiry);
   159	
   160	    return {
   161	      accessToken,
   162	      refreshToken,
   163	      expiresIn,
   164	      refreshTokenJti: jti,
   165	      refreshTokenExpiresAt: expiresAt,
   166	    };
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  /**
   170	   * Validate and decode an access token
   171	   *
   172	   * @returns Token claims if valid, null if invalid or expired
   173	   */
   174	  async validateAccessToken(token: string): Promise<AccessTokenClaims | null> {
   175	    try {
   176	      const { payload } = await jose.jwtVerify(token, this.secret, {
   177	        issuer: this.config.issuer,
   178	      });
   179	
   180	      // Validate required claims
   181	      if (
   182	        typeof payload.sub !== 'string' ||
   183	        typeof payload.email !== 'string' ||
   184	        typeof payload.name !== 'string' ||
   185	        typeof payload.provider !== 'string' ||
   186	        typeof payload.jti !== 'string'
   187	      ) {
   188	        return null;
   189	      }
   190	
   191	      return {
   192	        iss: 'mconnect',
   193	        sub: payload.sub,
   194	        email: payload.email,
   195	        name: payload.name,
   196	        provider: payload.provider as OAuthProvider,
   197	        iat: payload.iat ?? 0,
   198	        exp: payload.exp ?? 0,
   199	        jti: payload.jti,
   200	      };
   201	    } catch (error) {
   202	      // Token is invalid, expired, or signature mismatch
   203	      if (error instanceof jose.errors.JWTExpired) {
   204	        return null;
   205	      }
   206	      if (error instanceof jose.errors.JWTClaimValidationFailed) {
   207	        return null;
   208	      }
   209	      if (error instanceof jose.errors.JWSSignatureVerificationFailed) {
   210	        return null;
   211	      }
   212	      // Log unexpected errors but still return null
   213	      console.error('Unexpected JWT validation error:', error);
   214	      return null;
   215	    }
   216	  }

   220	   *

   222	   */

   226	        issuer: this.config.issuer,
   227	      });
   228	
   229	      // Validate required claims
   230	      if (
   231	        typeof payload.sub !== 'string' ||
   232	        typeof payload.jti !== 'string'
   233	      ) {
   234	        return null;
   235	      }
   236	
   237	      return {

   239	        sub: payload.sub,
   240	        iat: payload.iat ?? 0,
   241	        exp: payload.exp ?? 0,
   242	        jti: payload.jti,

   248	      }

   344	
   345	## 6. Pre-mortem (deliberate mode — 4 scenarios, addresses Critic FAIL: missing protocol-drift scenario)
   346	
   347	### Scenario 1 — *Tauri Windows terminal bridge fails*
   348	
   349	**Causes**: Tauri 2.0 webview2 ↔ node-pty IPC has Windows-specific framing bug. Switchboard/Orchestrator/jcode all chose Electron in part for this reason.
   350	
   351	**Mitigations baked in**:
   352	- Phase 0 hard gate runs on Windows CI runner.
   353	- **Kill criterion is in Phase 0 itself, NOT Phase 5**: failure = swap to Electron before Phase 1 UI work. 1-week Electron swap reserved in Phase 0 budget.
   354	- Phase 4 cross-platform soak repeats on Windows.
   355	
   356	### Scenario 2 — *Worktree cleanup leaves dangling state on crash*
   357	
   358	**Causes**: `mconnect` killed mid-worktree-create; agent process exits without invoking cleanup hook.
   359	
   360	**Mitigations baked in**:
   361	- `WorktreeRuntime.gcDangling({ runningAgentIds })` runs on every CLI startup; sweeps `.shards/` directories whose agent ID is not in current session registry.
   362	- Phase 3 verification gate explicitly tests the kill-mid-flow scenario.
   363	- Phase 4 soak runs 24h with simulated kills every 30min and asserts no leaked worktrees.
   364	
   365	### Scenario 3 — *Fork/resume corrupts session state for the original session*
   366	
   367	**Causes**: Fork copies scrollback rows; if FK constraint or trigger misfires, original session loses rows or gains duplicate `(session_id, line_number)` pairs.
   368	
   369	**Mitigations baked in**:
   370	- Migration `003_scrollback_message_id.sql` adds `message_id` column without altering existing PK `(session_id, line_number)`. Fork copies via `INSERT INTO scrollback SELECT ... FROM scrollback WHERE session_id = ? AND message_id <= ?` into a new `session_id`.
   371	- Phase 3 e2e asserts row counts match expectation in BOTH original and forked session after fork.
   372	- Phase 4 soak runs fork every 30min for 24h; assertion at end: original session row counts strictly monotonically increasing, forked sessions have exact expected lengths.
   373	
   374	### Scenario 4 — *Protocol/auth migration drift breaks iOS pairing + desktop attach* (NEW — addresses Critic-required missing pre-mortem)
   375	
   376	**Causes**: Desktop ships against v3.1 message families (`desktop:*`, `worktree:*`); CLI was at v2.0 silently `console.warn`-and-drop on unknown messages (`packages/cli/src/ws/ws-hub.ts:524-526`); shared/server/iOS were already v3.0; iOS returns nil for unknown server types (`packages/ios-app/.../Protocol.swift:391-452`). Without **explicit capability negotiation**, desktop and iOS appear connected but miss critical state messages, and the failure is silent.
   377	
   378	**Mitigations baked in (every one cites a Phase deliverable + verification gate)**:
   379	- Phase 0A deliverable: capability negotiation in `packages/shared/src/protocol/messages.ts` + typed `unsupported_capability` error replacing silent drop. Verified by AC11.
   380	- Phase 0A deliverable: CLI catch-up to `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '3.0'`. No desktop work begins until this is merged + green in CI.
   381	- Phase 0A deliverable: **`docs/protocol/v3.1-migration.md` compatibility matrix doc** with required sections (capability matrix / required for v0.2.0 / backward-compatible / hard errors). Verified mechanically in Phase 0A gate (`grep -q "^## Capability matrix"`) and in AC18.
   382	- Phase 4 deliverable: iOS regression test specifically asserts old TestFlight v3.0 build interoperates with new v3.1 server without disconnect.
   383	- Rollback plan: feature flag `MCONNECT_DISABLE_V3_1` in CLI + desktop falls back to v3.0-only message set.
   384	
   385	---
   386	
   387	## 7. Expanded test plan (deliberate mode, addresses Critic FAIL: under-resourced for cross-platform release)
   388	
   389	### 7.1 Unit (per-package)
   390	- `packages/desktop/__tests__/`: Tauri command serializers, session-list aggregation, fork-message-id math, status-notification dispatcher, perf-budget threshold checker, FTS5 query builder.
   391	- `packages/worktree/__tests__/`: create/list/cleanup happy path; dirty workspace; branch-name collision; crash recovery (mid-create kill → GC sweeps); concurrent create on same branch.
   392	- `packages/cli/__tests__/migrations/`: 002_scrollback_fts and 003_scrollback_message_id apply against fixture v0.1.10 db without data loss.
   393	- Coverage thresholds: existing CLI thresholds preserved; new packages require **75% statements / 70% branches / 70% functions**.
   394	
   395	### 7.2 Integration
   396	- Desktop ↔ CLI bridge: spin up CLI under PTY, desktop attaches via WebSocket, exchange 100 messages, no drops. **Repeats for v3.0 client + v3.1 client + mismatched-capability scenarios.**
   397	- Worktree multi-agent: 3 agents in same repo via worktrees; verify isolation by writing conflicting changes from each.
   398	- iOS protocol-v3.0 backward compat: build current TestFlight iOS app against new v3.1 server.
   399	- Cross-platform desktop install: dmg on macOS arm64; AppImage on Ubuntu 24.04; .deb on Debian 13; msi on Windows 11.
   400	
   401	### 7.3 E2E
   402	- **Fork-and-resume happy path**: open desktop → start session → run 5 turns → fork at message 3 → assert new session scrollback count == 3, original count == 5+ (new turns OK).
   403	- **Cold-start perf**: desktop cold-start TTI ≤ 2.5 s on M-series Mac and Linux x64; PSS ≤ 220 MB idle / ≤ 320 MB w/ 5 sessions.
   404	- **iOS pairing flow**: scan QR from desktop sidebar → iOS connects → terminal flows in iOS app unchanged from v0.1.10.
   405	- **Cross-platform CI matrix**: ci-build-macos, ci-build-linux, ci-build-windows, ci-hard-gate-macos, ci-hard-gate-linux, ci-hard-gate-windows, ci-e2e-macos, ci-e2e-linux. **All required for merge.**
   406	
   407	### 7.4 Soak / release-engineering (NEW per Critic)
   408	- **24-hour multi-agent soak**: scheduled nightly in Phase 4. Pass = 3 consecutive nights green.
   409	- **Notarization e2e**: signed + notarized dmg installs cleanly on a fresh macOS VM (codesign + spctl assertions in §5).
   410	- **Updater e2e**: install previous release → push new tag → app receives update within shortened 60s test window.
   411	- **Worktree crash recovery**: kill `mconnect` SIGKILL during worktree create; assert next `mconnect start` GCs the dangling worktree.
   412	- **DB migration regression**: fixture v0.1.10 db migrates to v0.2.0 schema without data loss; round-trip query equality.
   413	- **OAuth token security**: assert tokens not in scrollback rows, not in CLI logs, present in OS keychain only.
   414	- **Provider contract**: replay canonical Claude / Gemini / Cursor / Aider sequences; assert deterministic output.
   415	- **iOS WKWebView regression**: deferred since iOS side-panel is out of v0.2.0 scope. Re-enable in v0.3.x.
   416	
   417	### 7.5 Observability
   418	- Opik spans added: `desktop.session_attach`, `desktop.fork`, `desktop.resume`, `worktree.create`, `worktree.cleanup`, `worktree.gc`.
   419	- New Opik feedback scores: **Worktree Hygiene**, **Fork Fidelity**, **Cold-Start TTI**, **Idle PSS**.
   420	- Perf-budget script writes `.omc/perf-budget/<date>.json`; CI fails on regressions > 10% over rolling 7-day median.
   421	- Compatibility matrix dashboard: which capability negotiation paths are exercised in production traces (so we can flag silent-drop scenarios in real users).

    98	
    99	      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scrollback (

   106	      );
   107	
   108	      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connected_clients (
   109	        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
   110	        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
   111	        client_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(client_type IN ('pc', 'mobile')),
   112	        connected_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

   114	        priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal'
   115	          CHECK(priority IN ('exclusive', 'high', 'normal', 'low', 'observer')),
   116	        user_agent TEXT,

   134	      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_input_log_session ON input_log(session_id, timestamp);

   149	  createSession(session: Omit<Session, 'createdAt' | 'lastActivity'>): Session {
   150	    const now = Date.now();
   151	    const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
   152	      INSERT INTO sessions (id, created_at, last_activity, state, agent_config, working_directory)
   153	      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

   156	    stmt.run(

   158	      now,
   159	      now,
   160	      session.state,
   161	      JSON.stringify(session.agentConfig),
   162	      session.workingDirectory
   163	    );
   164	
   165	    return {
   166	      ...session,
   167	      createdAt: new Date(now),
   168	      lastActivity: new Date(now),
   169	    };
   170	  }
   171	
   172	  getSession(id: string): Session | null {
   173	    const row = this.db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(id) as

   185	    return rows.map((row) => this.rowToSession(row));
   186	  }

 succeeded in 0ms:
     1	# WebSocket Protocol v3.0
     2	
     3	Protocol specification for MConnect V2 real-time communication.
     4	
     5	## Overview
     6	
     7	Protocol v3.0 extends v2.0 with:
     8	- MCP (Model Context Protocol) message routing
     9	- OAuth JWT authentication (token in first message, not URL parameter)
    10	- Structured error responses with retry hints
    11	- Binary message support for large outputs
    12	- Push notification device token registration
    13	
    14	**Connection URL:** `wss://{host}/ws`
    15	
    16	**Max payload:** 1 MB
    17	
    18	**Idle timeout:** 120 seconds
    19	
    20	## Message Format
    21	
    22	All messages are JSON-encoded. Every message includes a `type` field as the discriminator.
    23	
    24	```typescript
    25	interface BaseMessage {
    26	  type: string;       // Message type discriminator
    27	  id?: string;        // Optional ID for request/response correlation
    28	  timestamp?: number; // Unix timestamp (server messages always include this)
    29	}
    30	```
    31	
    32	## Connection Lifecycle
    33	
    34	```
    35	Client                                    Server
    36	  |                                         |
    37	  |--- WebSocket connect to /ws ----------->|
    38	  |                                         |
    39	  |--- auth { token, clientType } --------->|  (must send within 10s)
    40	  |<-- auth_success { clientId, userId } ---|
    41	  |<-- session_list { sessions } -----------|
    42	  |                                         |
    43	  |--- session_attach { sessionId } ------->|
    44	  |<-- session_state { state } -------------|
    45	  |<-- agent_list { agents } ---------------|
    46	  |<-- control_status { state } ------------|
    47	  |                                         |
    48	  |--- terminal_input { agentId, data } --->|
    49	  |<-- terminal_output { agentId, data } ---|
    50	  |                                         |
    51	  |<-- heartbeat (every 30s) ---------------|
    52	  |--- heartbeat_ack { timestamp } -------->|
    53	  |                                         |
    54	  |--- session_detach -------------------->|
    55	  |                                         |
    56	```
    57	
    58	### Authentication
    59	
    60	The first message after connection **must** be an `auth` message. If not received within 10 seconds, the server disconnects the client.
    61	
    62	### Heartbeat
    63	
    64	The server sends a `heartbeat` message every 30 seconds. Clients must respond with `heartbeat_ack`. Clients that don't respond within 90 seconds are disconnected.
    65	
    66	### Input Arbitration
    67	
    68	MConnect uses a priority-based input arbitration system:
    69	
    70	1. **PC clients** have priority when actively typing (within a configurable idle window)
    71	2. **Mobile clients** can request **exclusive control** (5-minute timeout)
    72	3. Input from lower-priority clients is rejected with an `input_rejected` message
    73	4. Rate limiting applies: 100 characters/second per client
    74	
    75	## Client -> Server Messages
    76	
    77	### `auth`
    78	
    79	Authenticate with the server. Must be the first message sent.
    80	
    81	```json
    82	{
    83	  "type": "auth",
    84	  "token": "<JWT access token>",
    85	  "protocolVersion": "3.0",
    86	  "clientType": "mobile"
    87	}
    88	```
    89	
    90	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
    91	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
    92	| `token` | string | Yes | JWT access token |
    93	| `protocolVersion` | string | Yes | Must be `"3.0"` |
    94	| `clientType` | string | Yes | `"pc"` or `"mobile"` |
    95	
    96	### `session_attach`
    97	
    98	Join a session to receive real-time updates and send input.
    99	
   100	```json
   101	{
   102	  "type": "session_attach",
   103	  "sessionId": "uuid"
   104	}
   105	```
   106	
   107	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   108	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   109	| `sessionId` | string (UUID) | Yes | Session to join |
   110	
   111	### `session_detach`
   112	
   113	Leave the current session.
   114	
   115	```json
   116	{
   117	  "type": "session_detach"
   118	}
   119	```
   120	
   121	### `terminal_input`
   122	
   123	Send input to a specific agent's terminal.
   124	
   125	```json
   126	{
   127	  "type": "terminal_input",
   128	  "agentId": "uuid",
   129	  "data": "ls -la\n"
   130	}
   131	```
   132	
   133	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   134	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   135	| `agentId` | string (UUID) | Yes | Target agent |
   136	| `data` | string | Yes | Input data (including newlines for enter) |
   137	
   138	Subject to input arbitration and guardrail filtering.
   139	
   140	### `resize`
   141	
   142	Resize the terminal for a specific agent.
   143	
   144	```json
   145	{
   146	  "type": "resize",
   147	  "agentId": "uuid",
   148	  "cols": 120,
   149	  "rows": 40
   150	}
   151	```
   152	
   153	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   154	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   155	| `agentId` | string (UUID) | Yes | Target agent |
   156	| `cols` | integer | Yes | Column count |
   157	| `rows` | integer | Yes | Row count |
   158	
   159	### `control_request`
   160	
   161	Request or release exclusive input control.
   162	
   163	```json
   164	{
   165	  "type": "control_request",
   166	  "action": "exclusive"
   167	}
   168	```
   169	
   170	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   171	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   172	| `action` | string | Yes | `"exclusive"` or `"release"` |
   173	
   174	Rate limited to 1 request per 10-second window.
   175	
   176	### `scrollback_request`
   177	
   178	Request terminal scrollback history.
   179	
   180	```json
   181	{
   182	  "type": "scrollback_request",
   183	  "sessionId": "uuid",
   184	  "fromLine": 0,
   185	  "count": 100
   186	}
   187	```
   188	
   189	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   190	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   191	| `sessionId` | string (UUID) | Yes | Session ID |
   192	| `fromLine` | integer | Yes | Starting line number |
   193	| `count` | integer | Yes | Number of lines to fetch |
   194	
   195	Rate limited to 10 requests per second.
   196	
   197	### `mcp_forward`
   198	
   199	Forward an MCP message to a specific agent.
   200	
   201	```json
   202	{
   203	  "type": "mcp_forward",
   204	  "agentId": "uuid",
   205	  "message": {
   206	    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
   207	    "method": "tools/call",
   208	    "params": { "name": "read_file", "arguments": { "path": "/tmp/test" } },
   209	    "id": 1
   210	  }
   211	}
   212	```
   213	
   214	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   215	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   216	| `agentId` | string (UUID) | Yes | Target agent |
   217	| `message` | MCPMessage | Yes | MCP JSON-RPC message |
   218	
   219	Rate limited to 20 messages per second.
   220	
   221	### `heartbeat_ack`
   222	
   223	Acknowledge a server heartbeat.
   224	
   225	```json
   226	{
   227	  "type": "heartbeat_ack",
   228	  "timestamp": 1706745600000
   229	}
   230	```
   231	
   232	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   233	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   234	| `timestamp` | number | Yes | Timestamp from the heartbeat message |
   235	
   236	### `ping`
   237	
   238	Ping the server for latency measurement.
   239	
   240	```json
   241	{
   242	  "type": "ping"
   243	}
   244	```
   245	
   246	### `device_token_register`
   247	
   248	Register an APNs device token for push notifications via WebSocket.
   249	
   250	```json
   251	{
   252	  "type": "device_token_register",
   253	  "deviceToken": "a1b2c3d4e5...",
   254	  "platform": "ios"
   255	}
   256	```
   257	
   258	| Field | Type | Required | Description |
   259	|-------|------|----------|-------------|
   260	| `deviceToken` | string | Yes | APNs device token (hex string) |

docs/protocol/v3.md:1:# WebSocket Protocol v3.0
docs/protocol/v3.md:7:Protocol v3.0 extends v2.0 with:
docs/protocol/v3.md:9:- OAuth JWT authentication (token in first message, not URL parameter)
docs/protocol/v3.md:12:- Push notification device token registration
docs/protocol/v3.md:37:  |--- WebSocket connect to /ws ----------->|
docs/protocol/v3.md:39:  |--- auth { token, clientType } --------->|  (must send within 10s)
docs/protocol/v3.md:40:  |<-- auth_success { clientId, userId } ---|
docs/protocol/v3.md:60:The first message after connection **must** be an `auth` message. If not received within 10 seconds, the server disconnects the client.
docs/protocol/v3.md:77:### `auth`
docs/protocol/v3.md:83:  "type": "auth",
docs/protocol/v3.md:84:  "token": "<JWT access token>",
docs/protocol/v3.md:85:  "protocolVersion": "3.0",
docs/protocol/v3.md:92:| `token` | string | Yes | JWT access token |
docs/protocol/v3.md:93:| `protocolVersion` | string | Yes | Must be `"3.0"` |
docs/protocol/v3.md:246:### `device_token_register`
docs/protocol/v3.md:248:Register an APNs device token for push notifications via WebSocket.
docs/protocol/v3.md:252:  "type": "device_token_register",
docs/protocol/v3.md:260:| `deviceToken` | string | Yes | APNs device token (hex string) |
docs/protocol/v3.md:265:### `auth_success`
docs/protocol/v3.md:271:  "type": "auth_success",
docs/protocol/v3.md:273:  "protocolVersion": "3.0",
docs/protocol/v3.md:283:| `protocolVersion` | string | Confirmed protocol version |
docs/protocol/v3.md:287:### `auth_failed`
docs/protocol/v3.md:293:  "type": "auth_failed",
docs/protocol/v3.md:294:  "reason": "expired_token",
docs/protocol/v3.md:302:| `reason` | string | `"invalid_token"`, `"expired_token"`, or `"missing_token"` |
docs/protocol/v3.md:303:| `retryable` | boolean | Whether the client should retry (e.g., after token refresh) |
docs/protocol/v3.md:307:List of available sessions (sent after successful auth).
docs/protocol/v3.md:584:| `AUTH_FAILED` | Authentication failed | Yes (after re-auth) |
docs/protocol/v3.md:615:When the client has registered a device token, the server sends push notifications for important events (delivered via APNs when the client is not connected).

**Overall Assessment**: v2 fixes some v1 paper defects, but it is still not executable. The biggest blocker is that Phase 0A treats CLI v3 catch-up as a new-handler/file-scaffold task while the actual break is in the CLI WebSocket authentication lifecycle and database migration bootstrap.
